name: Zufar Dhiyaulhaq
description: Personal site of Zufar Dhiyaulhaq, Senior Engineering Manager at GoTo Financial. Writing and open-source projects on Kubernetes, service mesh (Istio), API gateways, networking, and cloud infrastructure.

resources.markdown_twins: Each post is also available as plain Markdown for agents: append `.md` to the post URL, without the trailing slash (e.g. https://zufardhiyaulhaq.com/why-i-run-the-fastgateway-demo-on-vcluster.md).

note: zufardhiyaulhaq.com is a static content website. It publishes writing and open-source project links and does not expose a callable agent endpoint: there is no A2A agent, no MCP server, no API, and no OAuth here. This manifest describes the site only as a content resource for AI agents. The resources listed above are plain files an agent can read directly.
